name: Myntra
tagline: India's leading online fashion and beauty marketplace, owned by Flipkart

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Make India look good: democratise fashion and beauty with the widest selection and trusted authentic brands.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be the default destination for discovering and buying fashion, beauty and lifestyle across India, at any speed.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Brand-led marketplace with owned private labels, logistics and content-led discovery; profitable growth over discount-led GMV.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Deep brand partnerships, size and fit data, fashion logistics and returns handling built over 15+ years.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: M-Now quick fashion plus AI styling; Myntra Glam beauty; FWD for Gen Z; international brands partnerships.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Does 30-minute fashion delivery create new demand or just raise cost-to-serve for already-profitable orders?

customers.pain: Want trendy styles fast without overspending or poor fit
customers.why: FWD feed, influencer content, deals at End of Reason Sale

customers.pain: Need authentic branded fashion delivered quickly, easy returns
customers.why: Wide brand catalogue, Insider loyalty, M-Now 30-60 min delivery

customers.pain: Worry about fake products and shade mismatch
customers.why: Authentic brand stores, Myntra Glam, reviews and creator tutorials

customers.pain: Need targeted reach and fashion-specific logistics, returns
customers.why: Largest fashion audience in India, ads, size data, omnichannel tie-ups

customers.pain: Need proof that spend drives fashion sales
customers.why: Closed-loop retail media; ads ₹914 cr FY25 (+28%)

products.name: Myntra app
products.desc: Apparel, footwear, accessories marketplace for 6,000+ brands

products.name: Private labels
products.desc: Roadster, HRX, Dressberry and other own brands

products.name: Myntra Insider
products.desc: Loyalty program with early access and rewards

portfolio.north_star: Monthly transacting customers keeping their purchase (net of returns)
portfolio.key_metrics: Conversion, AOV, return rate, repeat purchase, brand mix
portfolio.guardrails: Return cost per order, fit complaints, discount depth, delivery TAT

products.name: M-Now
products.desc: 30-60 minute fashion and beauty delivery, 10+ cities

products.name: Myntra FWD
products.desc: Gen Z trend feed with creator content

portfolio.north_star: Weekly engaged users who buy from discovery surfaces
portfolio.key_metrics: M-Now orders, delivery time, feed-to-cart rate, creator GMV
portfolio.guardrails: M-Now cost per order, cannibalisation of standard delivery, return rate

portfolio.north_star: Beauty share of wallet among existing fashion buyers
portfolio.key_metrics: Beauty GMV, ad ROAS, cross-category buyers
portfolio.guardrails: Ad load on browse, counterfeit complaints, seller fee churn

rows.how: Delivery and returns fees; ₹2,919 cr, ~48% of FY25 revenue
Convenience, platform and M-Now delivery fees

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Logistics 48%, marketplace 34%, ads 15% of FY25 operating revenue; private labels add margin.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Shoppers pay for goods; brands pay commission, logistics and ads, which form most revenue.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Fashion's high returns are the key cost; PAT ₹548 cr shows scale beat returns cost.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: M-Now speed, beauty, ads, Gen Z via FWD, tier-2 cities like Patna, Jaipur, Lucknow.

friction: Size and fit inconsistency drives returns
Return pickups and refunds can be slow
Heavy discounting trains users to wait for sales
Convenience fees feel like hidden charges
M-Now selection limited versus full catalogue

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Profitable at scale, deepest brand catalogue, Flipkart logistics and data

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Leadership churn (4 CEOs in 12 years), M-Now burn, Reliance pricing
